claimBoundary: This redesign establishes a prospective comparison and measurement seam. It does not establish learning, transfer, action-family superiority, controller benefit, or authority to launch model-backed work.
steps: Keep the failed pilot and its 30 matched cases sealed as development-only evidence.
Identify every decision by its exact policy-eligible move-family set before assignment.
Randomize only when at least two move families are simultaneously eligible; preserve singleton and mandatory choices as audit-only policy decisions.
Compare historical outcomes only within the same context, condition, support level, world scope, and exact eligible-family set.

Use two independent human coders as semantic outcome authority. Treat the deterministic observer as auxiliary: an opposite binary label or invisible delivery forces indeterminacy, while an inconclusive auxiliary label is nonconfirmatory and cannot erase exact human consensus.
Validate the assignment, eligible-set join, outcome rule, abstention behavior, and family-specific review criteria with zero-call fixtures.
Register any fresh collection as a separate fixed-size study with new jobs, seeds, destinations, routes, and spend ceiling; never enlarge it after outcomes are visible.

Keep Rowan Flat and Tideway Makerspace outside collection and memory until a later separately registered controller study measures independent work and transfer against current, stale, scrambled, contradictory, and no-memory controls.

comparability.rule: No record may support a controller decision whose candidate eligible-set id differs from the record eligible-set id.

measurement.semanticAuthority: exact agreement between two independently blinded human coders on visible delivery and outcome
measurement.familySpecificCriteriaSource: the requested action's saved pre-action success_signal and evidence_contract
measurement.fixtureMatrix: clear success, clear failure, and ambiguous evidence for each family admitted to a future collection

requiredBeforeLaunch: fixed sample size and turn horizon
fresh job identities and master seed
collection worlds and untouched held-out worlds
fixed model routes and reasoning settings
merged design, clean detached launch commit, and separate signed GO note
forbidden: reuse or relabel the sealed pilot as confirmatory evidence
outcome-dependent top-up, replacement, recoding, or threshold relaxation
forcing diagnose_elicit or fade_transfer into a comparison before a genuine co-eligible alternative exists
enabling the memory controller during collection
